name: phase_01_approval_workflow
lock_risk: Apply only during a maintenance gate. New Operations tables do not scan product rows; the membership-role history constraint rewrite takes an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE metadata lock and must abort under the bounded migration lock timeout.
representative_data: Exercise empty/current/previous migration lanes plus real PostgreSQL maker/checker, simultaneous decision, payload tamper, target-version, permission, assurance, Audit-outage, and response-replay tests.
query_plan_review: Approval reads are tenant-predicated and use tenant/created or tenant/idempotency indexes; authorization runs before cursor parsing and target execution locks the exact tenant membership and approval version.
space_risk: New rows are bounded approval metadata and canonical typed payload bytes. The existing role-history table receives one nullable approval identifier and constraint metadata; no backfill or table rewrite is intended.
forward_fix: Disable approval creation/decision/execution routes and add an ordered migration for any state, grant, constraint, or typed-target correction. Preserve every immutable request, decision, execution, cancellation, target history, and Audit fact.
rollback: Before release, remove only with all S07 state uncommitted. After release, never drop or rewrite approval or target history; disable routes and forward-fix. Never edit an approved payload/status directly or restore target authority outside the typed command.
